title: PHP Developer
job_description:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field More than 3 years of working experience in full stack web application development Strong experience in PHP and Laravel framework Strong experience in React.js , JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 Good knowledge of RESTful API development and integration Experience with MySQL or other relational databases Good understanding of Git/GitHub workflow, including branching, merging, and pull requests Familiarity with CI/CD tools and deployment processes Exposure to cloud or server deployment environments is an advantage Practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools in a professional development workflow Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team Good communication skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment Preferred / Added Advantage Experience with ERP , WMS , supply chain, inventory, or business process systems Understanding of enterprise workflows such as purchasing, inventory, warehouse, sales, or finance modules Experience with Docker, Linux server environment, or cloud platforms Experience with testing, performance tuning, and application security best practices What We’re Looking For A developer who can contribute across the full software lifecycle: development, testing, deployment, and support Someone comfortable with modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted coding , Git collaboration, and structured deployment workflows A candidate with strong business application understanding, especially in ERP or WMS domains, will have an added advantage

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong hands-on experience in PHP Laravel and React.js to join our development team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining web-based business applications. This role is ideal for someone who is technically strong across both backend and frontend development, comfortable with modern GitHub-based workflows , familiar with AI-assisted development tools , and able to support deployment and CI/CD processes in a professional software environment. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain web applications using PHP Laravel for backend services and APIs Build responsive, user-friendly frontend interfaces using React.js Integrate frontend components with backend APIs and business logic Participate in system architecture, database design, and technical solution planning Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-documented code Perform debugging, troubleshooting, optimization, and enhancement of existing applications Use GitHub for version control, pull requests, code reviews, and team collaboration Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment workflows Deploy applications to staging and production environments, and monitor release quality Work with AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar tools to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery speed within team standards Collaborate with product, QA, and business teams to deliver functional and scalable solutions Follow best practices in application security, performance tuning, and software delivery

EPF SOCSO EIS Annual Leave Training Provided 5 Working Days Medical and Hospitalisation Leave Annual Bonus Medical Insurance Flexible Working Hours Work from Home Allowance Provided
